1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.
Heard the counsel for petitioner.

2. The challenge is to Public Notice dated 31st July 2025 issued under Section 21 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 ('Act of 2013'), with respect to the land described in prayer clause.

8. Issue notice to the remaining respondent, returnable on 22nd September 2025.

9. We make it clear that no further action pursuant to the notice under Section 21 of the Act of 2013,
as against the land of the petitioner, be undertaken till returnable date.
10.
